messages:
Maya: Quick sync — planning the Optimize Toolkit beta gating. Need agreement on launch acceptance criteria for batching/caching/quant recs + eval-triggered alerts. Several customers pushed asks (Acme prod, Nova pilot).
Dan: high level: we can ship a minimal advisor that surfaces 3 rec types + one eval-alert flow. question: do we require model-level quantization support at beta?
Eunice: preference = keep quant recs advisory only for beta. full automated quant rollout is risky w/ quality regressions. we can include suggested quant config and a simulated econ impact estimate.
Raj: SLOs we should track: median p95 latency delta when batching on, tokens/sec throughput, and cost per 1k tokens. Also ops SLO: false-positive eval-alert rate <= 5% for the pilot.
Olivia: from customer signals — Acme asked for per-route rollout control + immediate fallback to hosted small model. Nova wants automated alert that triggers an eval only for high-severity customer queries. Both want clear rollback steps.
Maya: OK, proposal for beta acceptance (draft):
```
- Feature: Advisor panels for batching, prefix/KV caching, and quantization suggestions
- Must-haves: UI + API readouts, per-route recs, per-rec estimated token-savings and latency delta
- Alerts: Eval-triggered alert pipeline wired to one eval set (customer-provided + default), with manual ack/triage flow
- SLOs: p95 latency change <= +15% vs baseline, estimator error margin <= ±20%, eval-alert FP rate <= 5%
- Rollout controls: canary to 10% traffic, immediate fallback to pinned model
```
Dan: implementation notes: batching + KV cache metrics already emitted by runtime. we need a small service to compute recs and a light-weight UI. quant recommendations will rely on our offline bench + simulated eval on small sets.
Eunice: for eval-alerts we should limit to n=100 evals/day per customer in beta to control cost, and provide a dry-run mode that shows what would have alerted without triggering actions.
Raj: infra-bot: deploy check for beta: canary pipeline + alerting hooks present?
infra-bot: Canary pipeline exists in staging. Need config flag ENABLE_OPTIMIZE_BETA and a dedicated eval-queue namespace.
Olivia: prioritize acceptance gating: 1) rec accuracy (on seeded prompt set) 2) rollout controls + rollback safety 3) cost guardrails (token cap + eval rate cap)
Maya: timeline idea: 2 weeks for core rec service + UI skeleton, 1 week to wire eval alerts + dry-run, 1 week customer pilot enablement & docs. total ~4 weeks for closed beta.
Dan: dependency list: model-benchmarks (Eunice), runtime metrics (Raj), console changes (frontend), billing guardrails (finance eng).
Eunice: customer asks that influence scope: Acme needs per-model quant suggestion + ability to opt-out of quant; Nova wants alert-to-runbook linking. both feasible in beta if we scope automation down.
Maya: decision point: proceed with advisory-only quant + eval-alert dry-run for beta? thumbs-up = shipable in 4w.
Raj: +1 for advisory-only quant. keeps ops risk low.
Olivia: +1, but add explicit rollback playbook in docs before enabling any customer.
Dan: +1, I'll draft a tech spike to validate estimator accuracy this week.
Maya: great. action items: Dan doc tech-spike by EOD Wed; Eunice produce benchmark slices for seeded prompts; Raj configure eval-queue namespace; Olivia draft pilot runbook. I'll consolidate acceptance criteria and update the beta gating PR.
Olivia: noted, will share runbook draft in #product by Friday. :memo:
Maya: thanks everyone — will post a single-file checklist in thread when PR is opened. :rocket:
